tools.name: check_listings
tools.description: Check which MCP directories already list a public GitHub repo. 10 of the 26 directories have a public lookup, so those come back listed or missing (with the listing URL when listed) and the rest come back unknown. No login and no ManyCP server needed, works on every plan and on repos you do not own.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_directories, list_servers, get_server, check_listings, submit_server, sync_server · Private data: list_directories, submit_server · Public sink: list_directories, add_server, update_listing, submit_server.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_directories, list_servers, get_server, check_listings, submit_server, sync_server · Private data: list_directories, submit_server · Public sink: list_directories, add_server, update_listing, submit_server

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
